sections.title: Build the intuition
sections.subtitle: Start with a small model. Follow the numbers. Change something and see what happens.

sections.title: Make inference efficient
sections.subtitle: Understand what a model remembers, what it can reuse, and what survives compression.

sections.title: Find the right evidence
sections.subtitle: From vector geometry to agent memory: retrieve, measure, and question the result.

sections.title: Train, distill, experiment
sections.subtitle: Small models, limited compute, and the lessons hidden in the runs that did not work.

sections.title: Bring AI onto the device
sections.subtitle: Turn the mechanisms into local applications with explicit data and runtime boundaries.

posts.title: Inside the decoder. Beyond the cache.
posts.description: Follow a question through a trained two-layer decoder, then explore attention, KV layouts, speculative decoding, eviction, diffusion, and Next-Concept Modeling.
posts.scope: Browser labs distinguish the trained toy from illustrative calculations.

posts.title: Teach a laptop rock, paper, scissors
posts.description: A hands-on introduction to image classification: collect hand signs, fine-tune a Vision Transformer with LoRA, and try a live camera prediction.
posts.scope: The published page is a guide; camera capture and training run locally.

posts.title: Early TensorFlow learning notes
posts.description: An early notebook of TensorFlow Lite concepts, on-device constraints, matrix operations, and eager execution.
posts.scope: A short, unfinished learning log; no published Pages site.

posts.title: The machine-learning notebook shelf
posts.description: Colab notebooks covering photo inpainting, chunking, reranking, MiniLM classification, and GAN tutorials.
posts.scope: Exploratory notebooks and learning material, with upstream work credited in context.

posts.title: Pass the context. Skip the reread.
posts.description: Build cross-model KV transfer from first principles: paired calibration, layer selection, ridge regression, and removing then restoring RoPE.
posts.scope: Synthetic CUDA demonstration; not a reproduction of real-model quality.

posts.title: TurboQuant, from vectors to a phone
posts.description: Trace rotation, PolarQuant, and QJL, then inspect a Rust vector-search implementation and disk-backed Android benchmarks.
posts.scope: Separates independent-query latency from amortized batch throughput.

posts.title: NEAR, under the microscope
posts.description: Can neighborhood-aware residuals improve retrieval? Implement the method with EmbeddingGemma2, test it on SciFact, and inspect the geometry behind a changed ranking.
posts.scope: Small, inconclusive top-10 gain; lower Recall@100 and twice the vector-key storage.

posts.title: Memory an agent can actually use
posts.description: A map from readable memory files to hybrid retrieval, temporal state, evidence selection, and benchmarks for durable agent memory.
posts.scope: A research synthesis and starter architecture, not a benchmark-winning system.

posts.title: The pipeline ran. The quality gate did not pass.
posts.description: A three-stage experiment in query planning and diffusion fan-out retrieval on a 4 GB GPU, with the negative result and evaluation protocol kept visible.
posts.scope: DEV Recall@100 regressed; v2 TEST stayed locked. Not a full-scale reproduction.

posts.title: A smaller context, with the evidence intact
posts.description: Compare task-aware context selection for repository summaries, document QA, bug localization, and feature planning using local embeddings.
posts.scope: Small public fixtures and manual outcome rubrics; bug localization is not patch success.

posts.title: Harrier on MTEB: inspect the snapshot
posts.description: Explore the saved multilingual text evaluation for Harrier OSS 0.6B across classification, clustering, reranking, retrieval, and similarity.
posts.scope: 17 July 2026 snapshot: 96 of 99 tasks, 512-token cap; not an official leaderboard score.

posts.title: How small can a language model be?
posts.description: Compare roughly 9M–40M decoders under a controlled training setup, then study how a cleaner corpus changes the 40M model’s behavior.
posts.scope: The cleaner run improves perplexity, while generated samples still repeat.

posts.title: One token table. Two model paths.
posts.description: Share a frozen Gemma token embedding table between a causal decoder and a distilled bidirectional encoder, with split assets in an Android demo.
posts.scope: Uses EmbeddingGemma-300M as teacher; teacher alignment is a feasibility result.

posts.title: What survived the squeeze—and why
posts.description: Follow layer and vocabulary pruning, tensor slicing, PCA targets, and task-aware distillation through a candid ledger of baselines and failed paths.
posts.scope: Separates full-size quality controls, short compression pilots, and incomplete runs.

posts.title: Turn a 97M encoder into a diffusion generator
posts.description: Add a tied masked-language head and an instruction diffusion objective to Granite’s multilingual encoder, then generate through iterative unmasking.
posts.scope: Mechanism adaptation with local training reports; not a copy of LFM2.5’s architecture.

posts.title: Build a decoder from MiniLM’s vocabulary
posts.description: Reuse MiniLM’s tokenizer and word embeddings as the foundation for a 24-layer causal decoder with a tied output head.
posts.scope: Build and training pipeline; the README does not establish final generation quality.

posts.title: Fine-tune a small Gemma for code
posts.description: A local LoRA/QLoRA workflow for Gemma 3 270M IT, covering CodeX data preparation, training, evaluation, and adapter export.
posts.scope: Training setup for a small GPU; no published code benchmark claim.

posts.title: A geometric start for a smaller Harrier
posts.description: Initialize a 12-layer, 384-wide Harrier student with PCA/SVD and prepare multilingual training pools for teacher–student distillation.
posts.scope: An initializer and reproducible pipeline, not a finished compressed model.

posts.title: Private insights from a working day
posts.description: A local office-hours tracker that turns daily aggregates into short on-device insights, alongside session history and configurable goals.
posts.scope: Product page and source; an application example rather than a model benchmark.

posts.title: Ask Galaxy: search a personal digital life
posts.description: An on-device search design connecting query understanding, hard scope filters, parallel retrieval, ranking, and answers grounded in a bounded evidence set.
posts.scope: Public source and design notes. The advertised Pages URL returned 404 at review.

posts.title: KeySift: extract fields from document text
posts.description: Study frozen MiniLM attention for key–value linking, then combine text structure and local OCR in an Android extraction prototype.
posts.scope: Keeps oracle-span diagnostics separate from plain-text extraction; attention is a tie-breaker.
